name: fin-dashboard
description: Offline-first single-file Indian retirement corpus and income planning tool. FA-2025 / AY 2026-27 tax baseline, Monte Carlo sequence-of-returns simulation, FIFO SWP with capital gains accounting, joint-life household modelling, and Adviser/CA Pack export.
author: Stribog IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. <hello@stribog.com>
